name: fmp_etf_sector_weights
description:
Sector allocation of one ETF from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): weight per sector.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/etf-sector-weightings as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ETF ticker, sent as given, e.g. SPY).
Country mix: fmp_etf_country_weights; individual holdings: fmp_etf_holdings.
Example: {"symbol": "SPY"}
